content:
Nine days later, Muse has officially landed on Mac — click here to download.

Meta AI has just launched a brand-new app for iPhone, called Meta Muse. With an interface similar to Grok Bot, Muse is a personal AI agent that handles tasks on your behalf.

This reflects a recent trend among AI companies to anthropomorphise their AI agents by mimicking chat interfaces, making them feel more approachable and easier to understand.

Muse is also accessible via muse.ai on the Mac web version. The system lets you customise the agent's name and avatar for a more personalised experience.

Unlike other systems, Muse is free to use, but comes with a weekly cap; paying customers can unlock higher usage limits.

You can learn more about the new Muse agent design and its safety features here. Muse is now available on the App Store for iPhone users to download.

The app is currently only available in the United States and will roll out to more countries later.

Last month, Meta AI also launched a more powerful desktop app on Mac.

In the same month Muse debuted, Siri AI also made its appearance — seemingly Apple's move to upgrade its voice assistant for the chatbot era. While Siri AI can perform some actions, it has yet to become a full-fledged agent system like those demonstrated by OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceXAI and Meta AI.
